[NCBK.10.3] **An `event_id` stays on its engine.** The engine stamps every
`FactAssert` with its own `event_id` ([LFST.5.6]), a fact bridged from another
tier included, and offers no way to assert a fact under an `event_id` from
outside. An integrator bridging tiers does not carry `event_id`s across. To let
a tool or a rule recognise one fact on both tiers, the author declares an
identifying slot on the published schema and fills it ([LFST.7.2.4]).
